_comment: The monthly Skill Cup. Entries are scored by scripts/score-cup-entry.mjs (via the skill-cup workflow) and the month is closed by scripts/close-skill-cup.mjs. Themes are taken from the front of the queue each month. Never edit a closed cup.

themes.brief: Skills for sole traders and small shops: invoices, VAT and sales tax, late payers, suppliers, permits.
Skills for classroom teachers: lesson plans, parent emails, report comments, behaviour plans, marking rubrics.
Skills for unpaid carers: appointments, benefits forms, care plans, talking to doctors and care homes.
Skills for electricians, plumbers and builders: quotes, variations, snagging lists, safety paperwork.
Skills for students: essay plans, citations, scholarship applications, appeals, part-time work.
Skills for freelancers: proposals, contracts, scope creep, chasing invoices, rate rises.
Skills for charities and community groups: grant applications, impact reports, volunteer rotas, trustee papers.
Skills for housing: repairs requests, disputes, mortgage letters, service charges, moving.
Skills for cafés, restaurants and hotels: rotas, allergen information, reviews, supplier orders, licensing.
Skills for dealing with councils and agencies: appeals, applications, complaints, deadlines.
Skills for growers and producers: subsidy forms, buyer contracts, compliance records, market pitches.

cups.brief: Skills that help people read, check and act on medical letters, bills, test results and insurance forms.
